statement: One line holds a string s of lowercase letters. A happy prefix is a proper prefix of s that is also a suffix of s. Print the length of the longest one, or 0 when none exists. This is the border array's closing statement: build lps for s and read its final entry - the definition of that entry is exactly this question. One pass, linear time, and the fallback chain inside the construction does all the thinking.

example.why: abab is both a proper prefix and a suffix; nothing longer works since ababa is no suffix.

hint: No new algorithm - the border array's last cell is the whole answer.
mistake: Comparing every prefix against every suffix by hand; quadratic, and the border array already knows.
